definition: Jiaying Liu (Chinese: 刘家瑛) is a Chinese computer scientist whose research in computer vision includes highly-cited work on low-light enhancement, raindrop removal, and the recognition of human actions.
details: She is an associate professor and Boya Young Fellow in the Wangxuan Institute of Computer Technology of Peking University.
story: Picture walking through a crowd and instantly picking out a familiar face without reading a single name tag. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. It turns a picture into an understanding: this is a cat, that is a stop sign. Sight, for a machine, is a long climb from raw light to a name. And that is Jiaying Liu — giving a machine the gift of sight.
